title: lazy sunday norwegian egg rolls fritters
description: a light and flavorful norwegian dish featuring egg rolls, ice bath shock, and mediterranean-inspired ingredients
instructions: in a large bowl, combine eggs, grated potato, chopped onion, minced garlic, and sliced mushroom. mix well.
season the mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
add all-purpose flour to the mixture and mix until just combined.
cover the mixture and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the mixture into the hot oil.
fry the fritters for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and place them on a paper towel-lined plate.
immediately submerge the fritters in an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
once the fritters have cooled, serve them warm with your favorite dipping sauce.
